**Countries represented by EGOT‑winners whose award‑span exceeds 40 years**

| EGOT‑winner | First award | Last award | Span (years) | Country of birth |
|-------------|-------------|------------|--------------|------------------|
| Richard Rodgers | Oscar (1949) | Tony (1991) | 42 | United States (New York) |
| Helen Hayes | Oscar (1937) | Tony (1983) | 46 | United States (Washington D.C.) |
| Rita Moreno | Oscar (1968) | Tony (2012) | 44 | Puerto Rico |
| John Williams | Oscar (1965) | Tony (2008) | 43 | United States (New York) |
| Mel Brooks | Oscar (1948) | Tony (2010) | 62 | United States (Brooklyn) |
| Brian Grazer | Oscar (1971) | Tony (2017‑18) | 46‑47 | United States (New York) |

**Answer:**  
All of the EGOT recipients who completed their collection over a span of more than 40 years are from the **United States** (including the U.S. territory of **Puerto Rico** for Rita Moreno). No EGOT winner from any other country has a span exceeding 40 years.
